label: The name 'God' applies to
resolution: STMT-GOD-NAMES-NO-BEING-WF-P1, STMT-GRAMMAR-FIXES-REFERENCE and STMT-FIDEIST-REFERENCE-BUNDLE-FAILS-FOR-CATHOLIC-PRACTICE use the practice-use sense (DEF-NAME-REFERS-IN-PRACTICE). The nominal-definition leaves (STMT-GOD-NAMES-THE-FULLY-DESCRIBED-PRINCIPLE, STMT-GOD-NAMES-THE-UNIQUE-MAXIME-ENS, STMT-UNIQUE-PURE-ACT-FIRST-MOVER-IS-GOD) use the proper sense (DEF-GOD-NOMINAL-Q13). The link theorems noBeingExcludesFullDescription and noBeingExcludesUniquePureActFirstMover instantiate the leaves' predicate with the practice-use reference only as a schema: the rival relations on the leaves therefore hold under the open identification of the two senses, which no record asserts. No argument passes from one sense to the other. The analyst propositions STMT-PROPER-REFERENCE-PRESERVED and its stronger sibling STMT-GOD-NAME-SHARED-REFERENCE-EXTENSION now state the transfer explicitly; neither is adopted or attributed. STMT-PROPER-REFERENCE-LOST is an actual counterexample. NAME-APPLICATION-TRANSFER-CASES checks structural transfer/counterexample coverage using explicit excluded middle. Each of the three existing rival relations now has the exact proper-profile naming negation as subject, derived only from the raw practice no-reference thesis plus transfer plus a matching descriptor witness. This preserves the serious rival while preventing future raw practice-thesis refutation from automatically defending a proper nominal leaf. No existential descriptor witness or semantic transfer follows merely from a naming leaf.
